family.description: Exploratory re-measurement of the BCH contextual conversion family: gf2's production generator-matrix materialization BchCode::generator_matrix (the `materialize/fresh-alloc` row of crates/gf2-coding/benches/bch_genmatrix.rs, B1 (15,5), B2 (127,64), B3 (255,223)) against the established M4RI construction of issue 4e732b56 (fill the k shifted copies of the generator polynomial, then mzd_echelonize_m4ri). Three further exploratory cells measure the same bench's `reference/fresh-alloc` oracle bch_generator_matrix_by_encoding against M4RI, because the protocol-v1 pilot of this issue measured that oracle as if it were the gf2 route; they preserve that comparison under its correct name and do not enter confirmation. Each timed call constructs a fresh k x n generator matrix from an already-constructed code (gf2 allocates a BitMatrix; M4RI copies the prefilled matrix through its cached allocator and reduces the copy); the routes yield the same code in different systematic layouts, which the correctness gate checks by row-space equality. Code construction is setup outside the windows and is reported per execution. The baseline arm is always gf2 and the candidate is always M4RI, so a speedup above 1 means M4RI is ahead. These are current pinned measurements of both implementations, not a historical receipt and not an encoder throughput campaign. The family's v3 pilot and confirmation ran gf2 arms that reported `warm` without the protocol's untimed pass over the working set before calibration, so their gf2 `warm` declarations are false and their comparisons are withdrawn. This campaign re-measures every cell of the v3 pilot addendum with fixed gf2 arms that make that pass (timed_windows in dev/active/6fb89a3c/survey/gf2-side/src/lib.rs). Protocol v3 allows one confirmatory attempt per candidate identity and version; the withdrawn confirmation's ledger reservation holds the identity of every external candidate these cells use (m4ri-bch-genmatrix), whose executables are unchanged, so every cell here is exploratory and no interval carries a confirmatory decision. Pilot trials per cell, counting every committed campaign that started a pilot of this question under protocol v1 (family bch-genmatrix-consumer-pilot) or v3 and this campaign: bch-genmatrix-b1-vs-m4ri 3, bch-genmatrix-b2-vs-m4ri 3, bch-genmatrix-b3-vs-m4ri 3, bch-genmatrix-reference-b1-vs-m4ri 2, bch-genmatrix-reference-b2-vs-m4ri 2, bch-genmatrix-reference-b3-vs-m4ri 2. The search budget declares the maximum, within the protocol cap of 8; the earlier v3 addenda counted v3 trials only. The workload seed is carried for schema uniformity and no generator consumes it: the generator matrix is a deterministic function of the code. This survey adopts no production implementation; no cell here decides adoption.

effect.rationale: Comparator-gap cells only. This survey adopts no production implementation, so no worthwhile-speedup threshold applies and none is declared.
effect.equivalence_rationale: The one-sided non-inferiority margin the withdrawn confirmation froze; exploratory cells record decisions under it and never pass.
effect.material_gap_rationale: Material-gap threshold 1.2: the arms use different algorithms (gf2 fills the systematic generator column by column from a recurrence on the generator polynomial; M4RI reduces the matrix of shifted polynomial copies), so a 20% whole-construction gap is the smallest difference worth attributing to a named cause (operation count, allocation, word-level elimination) rather than to host noise; it is the threshold the withdrawn confirmation froze.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: The family reuses established harnesses and changes no production code; the whole diff is under dev/.
